pages.note: New page. Recipe verified on a project created with the published extension@4.1.30 (default template, TypeScript) plus unocss 66.10.5 and @unocss/postcss: postcss.config.mjs with the UnoCSS() plugin, uno.config.ts with content.filesystem globs and presetWind3, src/styles/uno.css holding only @unocss;, imported from the sidebar and content script entries. `npx extension build` emitted dist/chromium/sidebar/index.css carrying text-2xl, font-bold, text-blue-600 and font-semibold rules, and the content script's rules were shipped inside dist/chromium/content_scripts/content-0.js, which is what the content-script sentence says. The default output folder is dist/chromium, read off that build. The failure the page opens with (Can't resolve 'uno.css' with @unocss/webpack under rspack) is the measured finding in the Operation Kickstart ledger on Vue Devtools. Plugin, config shape and the @unocss directive read from unocss.dev/integrations/postcss. Every internal link resolves.
